default.notes: A visitor's visa must be obtained from a Grenadian mission or honorary consulate before travelling — there is no visa on arrival and no eVisa.

groups.notes: CARICOM nationals enter under Caribbean Community free-movement arrangements — a definite entry of up to six months is granted on arrival.
Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days; show a return or onward ticket and your accommodation address on arrival.
Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days under Grenada's waiver for Latin American passports — carry a return ticket and proof of accommodation.
Commonwealth citizens are admitted visa-free for up to 90 days; the officer sets the exact period on the entry stamp.
Visa-free for up to 90 days under a bilateral waiver — confirm the current allowance with a Grenadian mission before a long stay.
Visa-free for up to 30 days under the Grenada–China mutual visa waiver agreement; confirm the current terms before booking.
Commonwealth membership does not carry a visa waiver for this nationality — apply for a visitor's visa at a Grenadian mission before travelling.

GD.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Grenadian citizens.

TW.notes: Grenada recognises Beijing rather than Taipei, so ROC (Taiwan) passport holders should arrange a visa in advance — confirm with a Grenadian mission before booking.
